name: apple-passwords
title: Apple Passwords
description: Apple's Passwords app: category tiles with counts (All, Passkeys, Codes, Wi-Fi, Security, Deleted) and shared groups, a searchable item list, and a detail with copy buttons, a password that morphs into view, verification codes with a countdown ring, a “Copied” HUD, edit mode, security recommendations by severity, Wi-Fi networks with a QR code, and Developer Sign-In buttons (GitHub, Fly.io, Netlify, Replay) that run the real device-code logins through almostnode's CORS proxy, go through the tailnet when this tab is signed in to Tailscale with an exit node (the Safari block's node) and almostnode's CORS proxy otherwise, keep the tokens encrypted with a passkey, and check each token against its service. Three columns on desktop, two on tablet, a pushed stack on phones; light and dark.
